targets.authors: Cassidy, S., Roche, B., & Hayes, S. C.
targets.title: A relational frame training intervention to raise Intelligence Quotients: A pilot study.
targets.evidence_quote: This study aimed to replicate and extend the pilot findings of Cassidy et al. (2011) which found that teaching children to derive various relations among stimuli leads to increases in the full scale IQ scores of both typically developing children and those with educational and learning difficulties.
targets.outcome_quote: Experiment 1 showed that general intelligence, as assessed by the WISC IVUK increased significantly following a relational framing skills intervention. Thus, these findings replicate the pilot findings of Cassidy et al. (2011) using a somewhat larger sample.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit verdict that the findings replicate the pilot. Experiment 2 extends the same intervention to scholastic aptitude. Limitations and RAI correlations do not reverse the authors’ verdict on the original intervention finding.
